newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close up, led by brewing giant.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close up, led by brewing giant.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed up in a session dominated by demand for Colombia's giant brewer Bavaria, brokers said.

Bogota's IBB index rose 0.42 percent to 1,201.33 on trading volume of about 2.8 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index rose 0.62 percent, meanwhile, ending at 18,238.6 on 3.4 billion pesos in volume.
"Investors were excited about Bavaria today, expecting a strong showing in the first half and possible gains from the sale of Bancoquia," a Medellin broker said.
Bavaria jumped 1.89 percent to 8,050 pesos per share in Bogota and ended up 1.51 percent at 8,020 pesos per share in Medellin.
ING Barings upgraded the beer maker to buy from hold Friday on expectations of strong second quarter results. Barings also set Bavaria's 12-month target price at $9.30 per share.

Meanwhile, Grupo Santander de Espana has until July 30 to complete a $146 million deal to buy 55 percent of the Colombian bank Bancoquia, renamed Banco Santander Colombia last week, from the Bavaria industrial group.
